company.name: Colliers International Group Inc. Subordinate Voting Shares

title: Colliers Announces Normal Course Issuer Bid
summary: TORONTO, May 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Colliers International Group Inc. (NASDAQ: CIGI) (TSX: CIGI) (“Colliers”) announced today that the Toronto Stock Exchange (the “TSX”) has accepted a notice of its intention to make a normal course issuer bid (the “NCIB”) with respect to its outstanding subordinate voting shares (the “Subordinate Voting Shares”). The notice provides that Colliers may, during the twelve month period commencing May 15, 2026 and ending no later than May 14, 2027, purchase through the facilities of the TSX, alternative Canadian Trading Systems or The NASDAQ Stock Market (“Nasdaq”) up to 4,300,000 Subordinate Voting Shares in total, being approximately 10% of the 43,850,289 shares comprising the “public float” as of May 12, 2026 of such class of shares.
